description: A seller's active OLX offers by user id, uuid or profile URL, with category filter and sort. 1 point per returned record.

domain.description: Marketplace. Options: olx.pl = olx.pl (Poland), olx.ua = olx.ua (Ukraine), olx.ro = olx.ro (Romania), olx.bg = olx.bg (Bulgaria), olx.pt = olx.pt (Portugal), olx.kz = olx.kz (Kazakhstan), olx.uz = olx.uz (Uzbekistan)

sort.description: Sort by. Options: relevance = Relevance, newest = Newest, oldest = Oldest, price_asc = Price: low to high, price_desc = Price: high to low

start_page.description: Starting page (50 offers per page, up to 20)

user.description: User. e.g. User id, uuid or profile URL, e.g. 888517085

name: run_olx_users_offers
